race.comment: CLASSIC TWO (1) deep into the preparation and a win looks imminent in a very thin Maiden. Strong through the line in an average run contest to secure third over 1350m at Wyong. Maps well again and no excuses over the extra trip. CREATOR OF WORLD (2) trained locally and the winkers come off for this. Speared across from the outside draw and faded late to run sixth over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Placed over this track and trip three back, can find winning form. NEFERUSOBEK (10) resumes. Failed to draw a decent gate last time in and can sprint well fresh from the low draw. Fitted with the one 800m trial and not without each-way prospects. THE HARD ROAD (5) pass mark first up with the 59kg when holding his ground to the line to run fourth over 1200m at Nowra. Cross-over noseband goes on and will keep improving as he stretches out in trip.
